answer: A sybil farm splitting identities across many wallets gains nothing, since every new wallet starts at the base of the knoll and must climb through costly, time-delayed attestations. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake tokens locked along a public reputation ledger, and voting weight follows a slow spiral of earned trust rather than raw wallet count. Honest agents build standing like a river carving its channel, so forging parallel identities costs far more than the rewards any single duplicate could capture. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
